works.author: @flornkm

acceptedSamples.description: Initial complete Finder Documents view: persistent traffic lights, back/forward, four view modes, grouping/share/tag/more tools and Search. Sidebar Recents/Shared, Favorites Applications/Desktop/Documents/Downloads, Locations iCloud Drive/MacBook Pro/Macintosh HD/AirDrop/Network/Trash, seven color tags Red through Gray. Four files IMG_2355.jpg, IMG_2200.jpg, DINAMO Trial Fonts (3).zip and Account statement 2.pdf. No sticker yet.

Source camera zooms into the same four file thumbnails and filenames. Black pointer rests over the first photo IMG_2355.jpg; no selection/sticker state is yet visible. Sidebar/toolbar are temporarily outside the source camera crop.

First photo has left its grid position and is tilted clockwise while moving lower into the same white Finder file canvas. IMG_2355.jpg label becomes pale beneath the floating photo, with source pointer following below it. Remaining three files stay in their original row.

First photo is now settled at the lower right of the file canvas, slightly rotated with a fully visible filename. The pointer is over the ZIP file and its left paper corner is visibly peeling diagonally while the ZIP remains in the top row. Second photo and PDF remain unmoved.

Full Finder window returns. First architecture photo rests at lower right with a slight rotation; ZIP has moved to mid-left and rotated counterclockwise. Garden photo and PDF remain in the initial row. Pointer is over the garden photo.

Full Finder window. Garden photo is now lowered near the center, tilted clockwise, with its filename below. Architecture photo lower right and ZIP mid-left remain in their moved positions. PDF is still in the top row; pointer is on its document thumbnail.

Source camera zooms into scattered stickers. Garden photo and architecture photo retain their rotated positions. PDF has moved from its top-row position and is partly above this camera crop, with its filename visible. ZIP is partly cropped at left. Pointer is over garden photo; no file-opening result appears.

Close camera remains on scattered files. Architecture photo has a large curled top-left peel revealing a pale back surface; pointer lies near its right edge. Garden photo, ZIP and PDF keep their scattered positions. No modal or new content appears.

Camera pulls back to complete Finder window. Architecture photo has been moved a second time, now upright toward upper-left of the scattered cluster. ZIP stays lower-left, garden photo center, PDF upper-right tilted counterclockwise. Pointer is on architecture photo. All toolbar and sidebar regions remain unchanged.

Final complete Finder view holds four independently scattered file stickers: architecture photo upper-left of cluster, garden photo center, ZIP lower-left, PDF upper-right. Filenames remain attached under each object. All sidebar groups and toolbar remain visible; there is no filesystem save, new document, or opened preview result.

Close camera shows architecture photo peeling diagonally from top-left, with a large pale backside flap and cast shadow; label stays at initial slot. Garden photo, ZIP and PDF remain in the initial row. This is a visible peel/lift state before the first drag.

Garden photo is being dragged left and down from its initial slot, rotated counterclockwise with lighter filename beneath; pointer remains on the photo. Architecture and ZIP retain moved positions; PDF remains in top row. Full Finder regions stay visible.

PDF shows a large diagonal peel/lift with pale backside and faded filename while pointer sits below-right. The other three files keep their scattered positions; full Finder sidebar and toolbar remain visible. This confirms PDF peel before its settled rotated placement.

mechanisms: Persistent Finder window with traffic lights, navigation, four view modes, grouping/share/tag/more/search toolbar, full 19-row sidebar, and four file objects.

Architecture photo peels, lifts, rotates and drags to lower right. ZIP peels and moves lower-left. Garden photo lifts and moves to center. PDF peels and moves down-left, tilted. Architecture photo is peeled a second time and moved upper-left.
Faded filename and cast shadow accompany lift/drag; filenames remain attached horizontally under each settled object.
Source camera zooms into file gestures and returns to full Finder; the same objects remain throughout.
differences: Original independent SVG cathedral/street and garden/greenhouse scenes replace the source photo pixels; ZIP/PDF/toolbar/sidebar icons are also independently drawn. No remote media pixels are included in module assets.

Landscape 1920x1080 adaptation keeps the complete Finder window visible continuously instead of source camera crops; file positions and spacing are adjusted for larger 24px labels and safe long file labels.
26 seconds allows initial and final reading while preserving observed object-action order; source lasts 17.685 seconds.
Cursor press-scale feedback and exact drag timings/paths are authored explanatory animation, not proof of native mouse-down events.
Garden peel shape is adapted from the clearly observed photo/PDF peel mechanism; accepted garden frame directly confirms lift/drag but not the full initial peel.
unknowns: Actual operating-system filesystem operations, persistence, file contents and application implementation are unknown. No real service action is represented.
Native click/press/release event logs are unavailable. The source pointer and visible file movement are observed; event boundaries are authored.
No toolbar navigation, file-opening preview, typing, new document or save completion is observed.
works.sourceObservationMethod: Exact source card modal and original href read; original remote video actually paused/viewed at accepted decoded samples. No remote pixels distributed. Not a full original source-code replica or real service execution.
